entities.summary: Universitas Bunda Mulia (UBM) is a private university in Indonesia, with a primary campus located in North Jakarta. UBM is one of the few higher education institutions in Indonesia that has received dual accreditation: "Unggul" (Excellent) from BAN-PT and "International" from ASIIN.
